name: Love in the Clouds Above Trinity
source:
Love in the Clouds above Trinity is a kinetic visual novel.
It tells the sweet and passionate story of the fated meeting of two people, Jack and Christine, in the clouds above Trinity.
While the story, in words and renders, is fairly female friendly, that does not mean there is no sex, quite the opposite is the case.
translation:
《三一云端之恋》是一部动词小说。

它讲述杰克与克里斯蒂娜在三一上空云端命中注定的相遇，以及两人甜蜜而热烈的故事。

虽然文字与画面整体上对女性玩家友好，但这并不意味着没有性爱，事实恰恰相反。
